intent: new gallery-specific portraits with identity references

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a NEW gallery-exclusive character portrait for an elegant personal art gallery website, NOT a reuse or crop of the reference illustration. Input image is identity and style REFERENCE ONLY, not the composition to reproduce. Make one single character illustration on a genuinely transparent alpha background (no opaque paper rectangle, no checkerboard pattern, no letters, no border). Refined gentle Japanese fantasy storybook anime, thin warm grey-brown lines, translucent low-saturation watercolor, large clear shapes. Keep face and eyes crisp and hands well drawn; delicately feather the outer hair and clothing contours with translucent watercolor pigment, and dissolve the lower torso gracefully into alpha over a broad soft irregular wash, with no flat cut edge or hard sticker outline, no white fringe. Square composition, three-quarter waist-up portrait turned slightly toward the LEFT because the website title is to its left. Entire head/hat and both hands must be inside frame with comfortable transparent margins. No scenery or furniture; only the specified gallery props. Preserve the exact identity, hairstyle, signature clothes, accessories, colors and adult proportions of the reference. No other people, chibi, text, weapons, redesign or photorealism. Subject: Noval, an adult silver-white-haired young traveler, fluffy side-tied hair with pale blue ribbon, tiny white flower hair ornament, pale blue-grey eyes, warm ivory blouse and mist-blue cape, five-petal flower clasp, braided cord and small blue crystal. NEW POSE: she gently lifts a single small landscape art print with both hands at chest height, looking fondly down and slightly left at the print with a subtle bright curious smile, as if discovering a favorite photograph to add to the gallery. The print shows a tiny quiet pale-blue distant mountain landscape, no writing. Hands positioned naturally on two lower corners, visible face and flower clasp. No open notebook, book, loose writing papers or pointing pose. Light airy ivory and mist-blue washes, natural delicate morning light. This must feel newly painted specifically for a picture gallery.
